# tenacious in our search for transformative therapies

[ LEARN ABOUT US ][28]

## TARA-002

TARA-002 is the Company’s lead investigational cell therapy based on the broad immunopotentiator
OK-432, which is approved in Japan and Taiwan for multiple oncologic indications and lymphatic
malformations (LMs). We are evaluating TARA-002 for the treatment of non-muscle invasive bladder
cancer (NMIBC) and LMs in the U.S., for which it has been granted Rare Pediatric Disease Designation
by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

[ Learn more about TARA-002 ][29]

## IV CHOLINE CHLORIDE

An investigational phospholipid substrate replacement therapy for patients on parenteral support
(PS). Approximately 80% of PS patients are choline deficient and have some degree of liver damage.
IV Choline Chloride has the potential to become the first FDA approved IV choline formulation for PS
patients.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT IV Choline Chloride ][30]

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

Therapy. This minimally invasive treatment uses sterile water vapor to ablate targeted prostate
tissue, providing a precise option for appropriate candidates who may be looking for an alternative

health to determine whether Vanquish Water Vapor Therapy is the right fit for your needs.

[Learn more][76]
[Prostate Artery Embolization (PAE)]

### Prostate Artery Embolization (PAE)

Dr. Naveen Kella offers Prostate Artery Embolization (PAE) as a minimally invasive treatment option
for men experiencing symptoms of an enlarged prostate. This procedure works by reducing blood flow
to the prostate, allowing it to gradually shrink and helping improve symptoms such as frequent
urination, weak stream, and incomplete bladder emptying. PAE is performed without traditional
surgery and may be a good option for patients who are seeking a less invasive approach to treatment.
Our team takes the time to evaluate each patient’s symptoms, overall health, and treatment goals to
determine whether this procedure is appropriate. Our goal is to help patients find effective
treatment options that fit their individual needs while minimizing disruption to daily life. Dr.
Kella will guide you through the evaluation process and discuss whether PAE is the right choice for
your care.

[Learn more][77]
[Varicocele patient]

### Varicocele Treatment

Dr. Naveen Kella provides comprehensive evaluation and treatment for conditions affecting male
reproductive health, including Varicocele. A varicocele is an enlargement of veins within the
scrotum that can affect comfort, testosterone levels, and fertility. Some patients may experience
symptoms such as a dull ache, heaviness, or concerns related to fertility, while others may have no
noticeable symptoms. When appropriate, treatment can help improve symptoms and support overall
reproductive health. Dr. Kella takes a personalized approach to care, carefully evaluating each
patient’s condition and goals. Treatment options will be discussed in detail to ensure you
understand the benefits, expectations, and whether intervention is recommended.

[Learn more][78]
[Hydrogel image]

### Radiation Treatment - Rectal Spacer

Dr. Naveen Kella offers rectal spacer placement as a supportive step for men undergoing prostate
radiation therapy. A rectal spacer is a temporary, absorbable gel placed between the prostate and
rectum to create space and help reduce radiation exposure to nearby tissue. For many patients, a
spacer may help lower the risk of bowel-related side effects during and after radiation treatment.
Our team considers your anatomy, treatment plan, and overall health to decide whether a spacer is
recommended as part of radiation planning. We focus on delivering advanced care that makes effective
treatments safer and more comfortable. Dr. Kella will review the benefits and expectations for
spacer placement and help you understand how it fits into your overall radiation treatment approach.

[Learn more][79]
[Pelvis x ray for brachytherapy]

### Radiation Treatment - Brachytherapy

localized prostate cancer. This approach places tiny radioactive “seeds” directly into the prostate
to deliver focused treatment where it’s needed while limiting radiation exposure to surrounding
tissue. Brachytherapy is typically performed as an outpatient procedure and may be a good fit for
patients who want an effective treatment option with a shorter overall time commitment than many
external-beam radiation schedules. Dr. Kella and our team review your PSA, imaging, prostate size,
urinary symptoms, and overall goals to determine whether brachytherapy is appropriate. Our priority
is helping you choose a treatment plan that aligns with both cancer control and quality of life.
We’ll guide you through the evaluation process, coordinate with experienced radiation oncology
partners when indicated, and explain what to expect before, during, and after treatment.

[Learn more][80]
[Image of the bladder]

### New Bladder Cancer Treatments

such as BCG and Zusduri (Adstiladrin), for appropriate patients. These treatments are delivered
directly into the bladder and are often used for certain non–muscle-invasive bladder cancer cases
based on stage, grade, and prior response. BCG has long been a standard therapy for higher-risk
non–muscle-invasive disease, while newer options like Zusduri may be considered when additional
approaches are needed. Our team takes time to review pathology results, prior treatments, and your
overall health to determine which strategy best matches your goals. Our goal is to provide clear
guidance and a personalized plan while minimizing disruption to daily life. Dr. Kella will walk you
through the recommended next steps, explain what to expect during treatment, and coordinate
follow-up so you feel informed at each stage of care.

[Learn more][81]

## THROUGH COMPREHENSIVE CANCER CARE

Our initiatives focus on providing holistic support to cancer patients. We aim to enhance their
quality of life through medical assistance, emotional support, and rehabilitation programs.

### [Treatment Support][48]

[Tab Treatment Support 3]

UHAPO offers holistic care support for cancer patients, encompassing molecular diagnostics,
chemotherapy day care, and palliative care services. The team includes oncology-trained nurses, pain
management specialists, and general physicians who provide personalized care. By integrating
advanced diagnostics with compassionate care, UHAPO ensures that patients receive effective and
tailored treatment throughout their cancer journey.

Palliative Care Support

### [Support Services][49]

[Tab Support Services]

UHAPO's support services address the multifaceted needs of cancer patients by offering
psycho-oncology counseling, caregiver support, and motivational programs. The services also include
dietitian consultations and yoga therapy to promote holistic well-being. By focusing on both
patients and caregivers, UHAPO fosters a supportive environment that aids in coping with the
challenges of cancer treatment.

### [Rehabilitation support][50]

[Tab Rehabilitation support]

UHAPO provides rehabilitation support aimed at helping cancer survivors regain independence and
improve quality of life. Services include physical therapy, counseling, and assistance with
prosthetics and wigs. By addressing both physical and emotional aspects of recovery, UHAPO ensures a
comprehensive approach to post-treatment rehabilitation.

### [Community Awareness][51]

[Tab Community Awareness]

UHAPO actively engages in community awareness to educate the public about cancer prevention, early
detection, and support resources. Through initiatives like the Cancer Conclave and support group
meetings, they foster a community that shares experiences and knowledge. These initiatives aim to
reduce stigma, encourage early diagnosis, and build a network of support for patients and
caregivers.

## EMPOWERING LIVES
## THROUGH COMPREHENSIVE CANCER CARE

Our initiatives focus on providing holistic support to cancer patients. We aim to enhance their
quality of life through medical assistance, emotional support, and rehabilitation programs.
* [Treatment Support][44]
* [Support Services][45]
* [Rehabilitation support][46]
* [Community Awareness][47]

### [Treatment Support][48]

[Tab Treatment Support 3]

UHAPO offers holistic care support for cancer patients, encompassing molecular diagnostics,
chemotherapy day care, and palliative care services. The team includes oncology-trained nurses, pain
management specialists, and general physicians who provide personalized care. By integrating
advanced diagnostics with compassionate care, UHAPO ensures that patients receive effective and
tailored treatment throughout their cancer journey.

Nurses
Attendant
General Physician
Dietitian
Yoga Expert
Pain Management Specialist
Palliative Care Support

### [Support Services][49]

[Tab Support Services]

UHAPO's support services address the multifaceted needs of cancer patients by offering
psycho-oncology counseling, caregiver support, and motivational programs. The services also include
dietitian consultations and yoga therapy to promote holistic well-being. By focusing on both
patients and caregivers, UHAPO fosters a supportive environment that aids in coping with the
challenges of cancer treatment.

Nurses
Attendant
General Physician
Dietitian
Yoga Expert
Pain Management Specialist
Palliative Care Support

### [Rehabilitation support][50]

[Tab Rehabilitation support]

UHAPO provides rehabilitation support aimed at helping cancer survivors regain independence and
improve quality of life. Services include physical therapy, counseling, and assistance with
prosthetics and wigs. By addressing both physical and emotional aspects of recovery, UHAPO ensures a
comprehensive approach to post-treatment rehabilitation.

Nurses
Attendant
General Physician
Dietitian
Yoga Expert
Pain Management Specialist
Palliative Care Support

### [Community Awareness][51]

[Tab Community Awareness]

UHAPO actively engages in community awareness to educate the public about cancer prevention, early
detection, and support resources. Through initiatives like the Cancer Conclave and support group
meetings, they foster a community that shares experiences and knowledge. These initiatives aim to
reduce stigma, encourage early diagnosis, and build a network of support for patients and
caregivers.

Nurses
Attendant
General Physician
Dietitian
Yoga Expert
Pain Management Specialist
Palliative Care Support

### released

practical steps to connect with urologists, nurses and professional bodies and to build lasting,
trusted collaborations that improve care.

### released

Our new guide, *Building partnerships with healthcare professionals*, gives patient organisations
practical steps to connect with urologists, nurses and professional bodies and to build lasting,
trusted collaborations that improve care.
